data.name: R.E.C
data.detailed_description:
A routine counter-terror operation turns into a waking nightmare. You are an operative deployed to dismantle a deadly plot. But uncovers a hidden bioweapons lab. 

Disclaimer:

The R.E.C represents a work-in-progress version of the game. The story, gameplay mechanics, visuals, audio, and other features are still in active development. As a result, the R.E.C DEMO may not fully reflect the final experience.

Many elements shown or playable in the R.E.C will change, be improved, reworked, or removed entirely before the full release. The final version of the game will likely include significant updates, additional content, and various adjustments based on development progress and feedback.

Thank you.

A Cinematic Blend of Action and Psychological Horror

R.E.C is designed as a shooter intensity with deep survival horror elements.

Combat is grounded and deliberate, balancing survival resource management with sudden bursts of aggressive, high-impact encounters. Every bullet counts. Every decision matters.

Switch Perspectives. Change the Experience.

The Player can Seamlessly shift between immersive first-person combat and cinematic third-person. Experience firefights up close through the protagonist’s bodycam.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3060 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 36 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070 / AMD RX 6800 XT (8GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
